negative.name: idmap-missing-field
negative.description: an idmap entry without its size
negative.expect: The option `fleet\.guests\.gaps\.mapped\.idmap\."\[definition 1-entry 1\]"\.size' was accessed but has no value defined

negative.name: idmap-unknown-type
negative.description: an idmap entry whose type is the lxc.conf letter, not uid or gid
negative.expect: A definition for option `fleet\.guests\.gaps\.mapped\.idmap\."\[definition 1-entry 1\]"\.type' is not of type `one of "uid", "gid"'

negative.name: idmap-twice
negative.description: lxc.idmap lines in lxcExtraConf beside the typed idmap

negative.name: idmap-on-vm
negative.expect: fleet\.guests\.gaps\.efi\.idmap: is lxc-only but kind is "vm"

negative.name: scsi-unknown
negative.description: a scsi hardware value the provider does not accept
negative.expect: A definition for option `fleet\.guests\.gaps\.efi\.vm\.scsiHardware' is not of type `null or one of "lsi", "lsi53c810", "virtio-scsi-pci", "virtio-scsi-single", "megasas", "pvscsi"'

negative.name: efi-no-datastore
negative.description: an EFI disk with no datastore, in an estate with no defaultDatastore (the provider would use local-lvm)

negative.name: efi-on-lxc
negative.description: an EFI disk on a container
negative.expect: fleet\.guests\.gaps\.mapped\.vm\.efiDisk: is vm-only but kind is "lxc"

negative.name: cloud-init-interface
negative.description: a cloud-init drive slot the provider does not accept
negative.expect: A definition for option `fleet\.guests\.gaps\.efi\.vm\.cloudInit\.interface' is not of type

negative.name: console-omit-and-type
negative.description: a guest that sets a console type and omits the console block
negative.expect: fleet\.guests\.gaps\.mapped\.console: console\.omit renders no console block

negative.name: no-pool-keeps-grant
negative.description: a guest in no pool with a vmid outside the estate pool's grant
negative.expect: fleet\.guests\.gaps\.stray\.vmid: vmid 9601 is outside the ranges granted to pool gaps/proxmox/gpool \(9500-9599\)

negative.name: adoption-unrecorded-bad-value
negative.description: adoption.unrecorded with a value that is neither ignore nor apply
negative.expect: A definition for option `fleet\.guests\.gaps\.mapped\.adoption\.unrecorded' is not of type `null or one of "ignore", "apply"'

negative.name: adoption-unrecorded-bad-default
negative.description: the same bad value in an estate's guestDefaults
negative.expect: A definition for option `fleet\.estates\.gaps\.guestDefaults\.adoption\.unrecorded' is not of type `null or one of "ignore", "apply"'
